rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict a tenant for owner or relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts per tenant, up to a per-unit maximum. An additional amount is due for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children. The amounts are adjusted each March 1.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $8,245.00 per tenant, max $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)

coverage_conditions.summary: Tenants served a notice of termination of tenancy for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation. The rate is set by the date the notice is served.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Rate depends on the date of service of the eviction notice.

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: Short temporary capital improvement evictions (under 20 days) fall under state Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than the local ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict tenants under the Ellis Act must pay relocation amounts per tenant, up to a per-unit maximum. An additional amount is due for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. The amounts are adjusted each March 1.
rules.key_value: For notices served 3/01/26–2/28/27: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant

coverage_conditions.summary: Tenants served a notice of termination of tenancy under the Ellis Act. The rate is set by the date the notice is served.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Rate depends on the date of service of the eviction notice.
